{"code": "from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Stratify by severity and compute treatment effect within each stratum
effects_by_severity = []

for severity_level in data['severity'].unique():
    subset = data[data['severity'] == severity_level]
    
    # Compute response rates
    trt_rate = subset[subset['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
    ctrl_rate = subset[subset['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
    
    # Compute difference
    effect = trt_rate - ctrl_rate
    
    # Store
    effects_by_severity.append({
        'severity': severity_level,
        'treatment_rate': trt_rate,
        'control_rate': ctrl_rate,
        'treatment_effect': effect
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
effects_df = pd.DataFrame(effects_by_severity)
print(effects_df)"}
